title: Concept: Conan requirement without a recipe revision
description: conanfile.txt declares a requirement pinned to a version but no revision, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a requirement pinned to a version but no revision.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through conanfile.txt (conan).
risk: Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a requirement pinned to a version but no revision.
